says: What a BAS / VAT201 return leaves out of its boxes (the period's own set-off and tax-payment entries) has ONE reader. The box (movementsBetween) and the Ledger page's labelled line (returnReading) both call it.
decided: 2026-11-28 batch 1141 (Athi: unify, do not build). Box 9 / box 14 stay the period's own movement; the stored close and the live return are compared on their own readings, never merged.
